svg.title: Teach Us to Pray
svg.desc: A one-minute comic in 5 panels. Panel 1 (Luke 11:1): Jesus standing alone praying with folded hands on open hills, and three disciples a little way off watching Him. Caption: "Jesus was praying in a certain place. His disciples watched." Panel 2 (Luke 11:1): a disciple speaking to Jesus, two others behind him. Caption: "When He finished, one of them asked." A disciple says: "Lord, teach us to pray, as John taught his disciples." Panel 3 (Luke 11:2): Jesus teaching the disciples the first lines of the prayer. Caption: "He said to them, "When you pray, say:"". Jesus says: "Father, hallowed be your name. Your kingdom come." Panel 4 (Luke 11:3-4): Jesus going on with the prayer, the disciples listening. Caption: "Then what to ask for." Jesus says: "Give us each day our daily bread, and forgive us our sins,". Panel 5 (Deuteronomy 6:7; Matthew 6:9): a father, a mother and two children at home with a loaf, praying together; a child says the first line. Caption: "And at your table." A child says: "Our Father in heaven, hallowed be your name." Deuteronomy says: "You shall teach them diligently to your children". The point: The disciples asked to be taught after watching Jesus pray. Pray where your children can see you, and teach them the words He gave, one line at a time (Deuteronomy 6:7).
svg.text: Luke 11:1-4 and a household's table, in one minute

g.text: Jesus was praying in a certain

svg.text: The disciples asked to be taught after watching Jesus
pray. Pray where your children can see you, and teach them
the words He gave, one line at a time (Deuteronomy 6:7).
Luke gives none of the words Jesus prayed in 11:1, so the first panel
has none. He names neither the place nor the disciple who asked.
